sentences.text: 1  to direct the respondents 1 and 2 herein to pass an award by refixin  compensation for the acquired lands situated at S.No.519/4 to the ex  950 Sq.Meters at Rs.120/- per Sq.ft as per the extent guideline valu  disburse the same to the petitioner with interest.

For Respondents : Mr.P. Sathish,
 Additional Government Pleader  ORDER Seeking for enhancement of the compensation, the award passed in the year 2018, is put under challenge in the present Writ Petition.
2. When the Land Acquisition Act itself provides that the L.A.O.P. should be filed before the Competent Court, the present Writ Petition challenging the award, cannot be sustained.
3. Accordingly, the Writ Petition stands dismissed.
